fact: On 16 April 2025 the Government of Liberia, the European Union and UNICEF signed a three-year partnership under which the EU and UNICEF support the Ministry of Education in modernising its EMIS and strengthening school-level record-keeping to identify dropout risks; the release gives no amount.
title: Government of Liberia, European Union and UNICEF Launch Partnership to Transform Liberia's Education and Youth Development Through Data-Driven Solutions
